mechanism_narrative: A lower federal funds rate (FEDFUNDS) is associated with higher S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 days, as lower rates reduce the discount rate for equity valuation.
failure_condition: SPX produces positive 20d returns in less than 50% of instances when FEDFUNDS < 1.5%, or the Rank IC over any 3-year rolling window is below 0.03.

mechanism_narrative: A federal funds rate above 2.5% signals monetary tightening, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 days as higher rates increase equity discount rates.
failure_condition: SPX produces negative 60d returns in less than 50% of instances when FEDFUNDS > 2.5%, or the Rank IC over any 3-year rolling window is below 0.03.

mechanism_narrative: Simultaneous decline in real personal consumption (RSAFS) and housing starts (HOUST) by more than 0.5% in the past month signals weakening consumer demand, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 days.
candidate_trigger: RSAFS decline > 0.5% and HOUST decline > 0.5% in the past month
failure_condition: SPX produces negative 20d returns in less than 50% of instances when RSAFS decline > 0.5% and HOUST decline > 0.5% in the past month, or the Rank IC over any 3-year rolling window is below 0.03.

mechanism_narrative: A regime of high unemployment (UNRATE > 4.0%) and declining payroll employment (PAYEMS decline > 0.5% in the past month) signals labor market deterioration, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 days.
candidate_trigger: UNRATE > 4.0% and PAYEMS decline > 0.5% in the past month
regime_hint: high unemployment and labor market contraction
failure_condition: SPX produces negative 60d returns in less than 50% of instances when UNRATE > 4.0% and PAYEMS decline > 0.5% in the past month, or the Rank IC over any 3-year rolling window is below 0.03.

mechanism_narrative: A low level of industrial production (INDPRO) signals economic weakness, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 days as manufacturing slowdowns reduce corporate earnings expectations.
failure_condition: SPX produces negative 5d returns in less than 50% of instances when INDPRO < 100, or the Rank IC over any 3-year rolling window is below 0.03.

mechanism_narrative: Industrial production (INDPRO) falling below 100 (the 2017 base year level) signals severe economic contraction, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 days.
failure_condition: SPX produces negative 60d returns in less than 50% of instances when INDPRO < 100, or the Rank IC over any 3-year rolling window is below 0.03.

mechanism_narrative: Simultaneous decline in real GDP (GDPC1) and real personal consumption (RSAFS) by more than 0.5% in the past quarter signals weakening economic demand, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 days.
candidate_trigger: GDPC1 decline > 0.5% and RSAFS decline > 0.5% in the past quarter
failure_condition: SPX produces negative 20d returns in less than 50% of instances when GDPC1 decline > 0.5% and RSAFS decline > 0.5% in the past quarter, or the Rank IC over any 3-year rolling window is below 0.03.

mechanism_narrative: A regime of high inflation (CPIAUCSL YoY > 2.5%) and low interest rates (FEDFUNDS < 1.5%) signals stagflation risk, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 days as real rates rise.
regime_hint: high inflation and low interest rate regime
failure_condition: SPX produces negative 20d returns in less than 50% of instances when CPIAUCSL YoY inflation > 2.5% and FEDFUNDS < 1.5%, or the Rank IC over any 3-year rolling window is below 0.03.
